newsitem.title: USA: PP&L asks industrial users to cut power use.
newsitem.headline: PP&L asks industrial users to cut power use.

text.p: Pennsylvania Power & Light Co (PP&L) said Friday it requested about 80 large industrial customers for a third day this week to reduce their power usage due to heavy weather-related demand on its system.
PP&L, headquartered in Allentown, Pa., asked those "interruptible" customers to begin curtailing their energy use at 1120 EDT.

The large customers whose service was to be interrupted have special contracts with PP&L--in exchange for cheaper rates--that require them to reduce power and/or curtail operations during an emergency, PP&L said.

In addition to calling for large industrial users to reduce their usage, PP&L as well as other utility members of the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Interconnect pool requested all customers to use energy sparingly and shift use of major electric appliances such as washing machines and clothes dryers to early morning or evening hours.
PP&L interrupted service to customers with those special contracts Wednesday and Thursday. On both days, normal service was restored the same day.
PP&L, a subsidiary of PP&L Resources, serves 1.2 million customers in central and eastern Pennsylvania.
